statutory_rules.title: Platform Fare and Commission Transparency Mandate
statutory_rules.summary: Requires transport network companies to provide clear fare calculation breakdowns and transparent commission deductions without arbitrary withholding.

statutory_rules.title: Fair Administrative Action & Deactivation Due Process
statutory_rules.summary: Mandates written notification and reasonable opportunity for driver response prior to permanent suspension or account deactivation.

statutory_rules.title: Driver Safety and Incident Reporting Protocol
statutory_rules.summary: Establishes emergency response obligations and safety reporting procedures for platform operators and drivers during on-trip incidents.

statutory_rules.title: Driver Verification & PSV Compliance Standards
statutory_rules.summary: Sets statutory requirements for valid PSV licensing, police clearance (Good Conduct), and vehicle inspection compliance.

statutory_rules.title: Right to Explanation on Automated Account Deactivations
statutory_rules.summary: Grants data subjects the right not to be subject to purely automated decision-making and entitles drivers to human review of algorithmic bans.

platform_rules.title: Service Suspension & Account Review Procedures
platform_rules.summary: Outlines temporary hold conditions for investigation of driver complaints or safety reports.

platform_rules.title: Fare Adjustments & Earnings Discrepancy Claims
platform_rules.summary: Provides mechanism for submitting trip receipts and cash payment evidence within specified time windows.

platform_rules.title: Termination Appeal & Evidence Review Window
platform_rules.summary: Defines driver rights to present counter-evidence prior to final contract termination.

platform_rules.title: Fraud Detection and Account Deactivation Review
platform_rules.summary: Specifies investigation protocols for flagged GPS anomalies, account sharing suspicions, or promotional abuse.

union_protocols.title: Union Representation & Formal Appeals Procedure
union_protocols.summary: Establishes Transport and Allied Workers Union advocacy rights and structured appeal presentation standard.
